text:
Sara K: Bringing up hf/ultra-chat-v2 in Redwood private — seeing generation flicker when prompts start with a leading space. Sometimes the assistant outputs a truncated first token. Anyone run into this?

Omar R: Can you paste the tokenizer config and a short reproduce snippet?

Sara K: Sure, here's what the model's tokenizer.json has right now:
```
{"normalizer": null, "pre_tokenizer": {"type": "Whitespace"}, "post_processor": null}
```
And quick repro in python:
```
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
t = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json')
print(t.encode('Hello').tokens)
print(t.encode(' Hello').tokens)
```
Outputs:
```
['Hello']
['Hello']  # same, leading space lost
```

Liam T: That looks like the pre_tokenizer removed prefix-space. Many HF byte-level tok models rely on add_prefix_space or a byte-level pre-tokenizer so they encode leading spaces as distinct tokens. If we strip normalization we might also lose byte fallback which handles rare unicode marks.

Maya P: We saw a small but consistent hit in our chat evals when the assistant's first token alignment shifts — ~3% lower exact-match on the conversational prompts (quick run on 2k evals). That's our quality regression signal.

tokenizer-bot: conversion script note: current hf->redwood conversion strips 'normalizer' entries to avoid double-normalization in runtime. It also defaults pre_tokenizer to 'Whitespace' if unspecified.

Omar R: Quick experiment suggestion:
- enable normalizer to NFC
- use ByteLevel pre_tokenizer with add_prefix_space true
- enable byte fallback in tokenizer model
Example config snippet:
```
{"normalizer": {"type": "NFC"}, "pre_tokenizer": {"type": "ByteLevel", "add_prefix_space": true}, "model": {"type": "BPE", "byte_fallback": true}}
```

Liam T: Note: changing pre_tokenizer will shift vocab indices for some leading-space tokens. We'll need to re-run embedding alignment and update the cached kv-cache offsets used in quantized runtime. Also check that older rolled-out checkpoints keep compatibility.

Sara K: Good call. I'll roll a dev canary with the new tokenizer settings against the canary dataset (2k convo eval, embedding-check subset). If eval pass then we'll schedule a controlled rollout. @eng-runtime please watch for any increased tokenization latency or cache-miss spikes.

Maya P: Also add a quick unit that asserts tokenization invariants for prefix-space variants to the HF->Redwood conversion tests.

Omar R: I'll update the conversion script and add the test. If the dev canary passes I'll coordinate with releases.

Sara K: Thanks all :thumbsup:
